correctness.rationale: A complete all-n induction establishes the exact graded type signatures, alternating path peeling, and precisely three mixed products for 1<=t<=n-2. Boundaries n>=3, t=0, n-2, n-1 are covered; ordinary two-type collapse and universal extremal bound are proved separately. The executed verifier checks n=3..70, independent pairwise graded back-and-forth via matching at n=2..7, and finite Boolean powerset closures at n=2..4. Experiments are not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural two-agent S5 grid has n^2 worlds. The explicit 2n-1-cell marking simultaneously maximizes the graded/ordinary quotient ratio at n^2/2 and yields a complete nontrivial sharp depth spectrum, showing an exponential Boolean-algebra-size difference between counting and noncounting expressiveness on the identical model. Generic graded counting expressiveness and prior ungraded Ferrers results do not answer this extremal finite question.
